LoraLoader.name: LoraLoader
LoraLoader.description: This LoRA loader is used to modify both diffusion and CLIP models, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

CLIPLoader.name: CLIPLoader
CLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:

stable cascade: clip-g
sd3: t5 xxl / clip-g / clip-l
stable audio: t5 base
mochi: t5 xxl
cogvideox: t5 xxl (226-token padding)
cosmos: old t5 xxl
lumina2: gemma 2 2B
wan: umt5 xxl
hidream: llama-3.1 (Recommend) or t5
omnigen2: qwen vl 2.5 3B
joyimage: qwen3-vl 8B
lens: gpt-oss-20b
pixeldit: gemma 2 2B elm
minimax: MiniMax H3 Qwen3-VL or Music3 Qwen/RVQ

DualCLIPLoader.name: DualCLIPLoader
DualCLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
sdxl: clip-l, clip-g
sd3: clip-l, clip-g / clip-l, t5 / clip-g, t5
flux: clip-l, t5
hidream: at least one of t5 or llama, recommended t5 and llama
hunyuan_image: qwen2.5vl 7b and byt5 small
newbie: gemma-3-4b-it, jina clip v2

LoraLoaderModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderModelOnly
LoraLoaderModelOnly.description: This LoRAs loader is used to modify the diffusion model, altering the way in which latents are denoised such as applying styles. Multiple LoRA nodes can be linked together.

max_duration.tooltip: Maximum duration in seconds; the model can end the song earlier.

MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode.name: MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode
MiniMaxMusic3TextEncode.description: Uses a MiniMax Music3 CLIP model to generate the acoustic conditioning sequence.

EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio.name: EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio
EmptyMiniMaxMusic3LatentAudio.description: Creates an empty MiniMax Music3 audio latent for the requested duration.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.name: EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV
EmptyMiniMaxH3LatentAV.description: Joint video+audio latent for MiniMax H3. Duration snaps to the model's 17k+5 frame grid at 24 fps.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, snapped up to the model's 17k+5 grid (124 = ~5s; trained range is ~124-362, longer is untested)

frame_idx.tooltip: Frame index to anchor the image or the clip's first frame at. Negative values are counted from the end of the video.

vae.tooltip: Video VAE, needed when an image is connected.

audio_vae.tooltip: Audio VAE, needed when an audio is connected.

image.tooltip: Image or video frames to anchor. Multi-frame batches are anchored as a clip and cropped down to the model's valid clip lengths: 5, 22, 39... (17k + 5) frames. Batches shorter than 5 frames use only the first image.

audio.tooltip: Soundtrack to anchor starting at the same frame index, cropped to the video's remaining duration.

MiniMaxH3AddGuide.name: MiniMaxH3AddGuide
MiniMaxH3AddGuide.description: Anchor an image, a short clip, audio, or a clip with its soundtrack at any frame of a MiniMax H3 video. Chain several nodes to anchor several frames.

length.tooltip: Frame count at 24 fps, (124 = ~5s, trained range is ~124-362)

ref_image_size.tooltip: Reference image sizing. 'match' scales each ref (down only, keeping aspect) to the generation's pixel area; 'max' uses the reference pipeline's 2048px short edge for best identity fidelity. Reference tokens ride through every sampling step, so 'max' can be several times slower.

ref_image.tooltip: Reference image (downscaled to 2048 short edge if larger, never upscaled)

ref_video_audio.tooltip: Soundtrack of the same-numbered reference video

MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.name: MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo
MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo.description: <Picture i> / <Video k> / <Audio j> reference conditioning for MiniMax H3. Use the same tags when prompting.

QuadrupleCLIPLoader.name: QuadrupleCLIPLoader
QuadrupleCLIPLoader.description:
Recipes:
hidream: long clip-l, long clip-g, t5xxl, llama_8b_3.1_instruct

LoraLoaderBypass.name: LoraLoaderBypass
LoraLoaderBypass.description: Apply LoRA in bypass mode. Unlike regular LoRA, this doesn't modify model weights - instead it injects the LoRA computation during forward pass. Useful for training scenarios.

LoraLoaderBypassModelOnly.name: LoraLoaderBypassModelOnly
LoraLoaderBypassModelOnly.description: Apply LoRA in bypass mode. Unlike regular LoRA, this doesn't modify model weights - instead it injects the LoRA computation during forward pass. Useful for training scenarios.

prompt_text.tooltip: Text prompt to guide the video generation

model.tooltip: Model to use for video generation

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

MinimaxTextToVideoNode.name: MinimaxTextToVideoNode
MinimaxTextToVideoNode.description: Generates videos synchronously based on a prompt, and optional parameters.

image.tooltip: Image to use as first frame of video generation

prompt_text.tooltip: Text prompt to guide the video generation

model.tooltip: Model to use for video generation

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

MinimaxImageToVideoNode.name: MinimaxImageToVideoNode
MinimaxImageToVideoNode.description: Generates videos synchronously based on an image and prompt, and optional parameters.

prompt_text.tooltip: Text prompt to guide the video generation.

seed.tooltip: The random seed used for creating the noise.

first_frame_image.tooltip: Optional image to use as the first frame to generate a video.

prompt_optimizer.tooltip: Optimize prompt to improve generation quality when needed.

duration.tooltip: The length of the output video in seconds.

resolution.tooltip: The dimensions of the video display. 1080p is 1920x1080, 768p is 1366x768.

MinimaxHailuoVideoNode.name: MinimaxHailuoVideoNode
MinimaxHailuoVideoNode.description: Generates videos from prompt, with optional start frame using the MiniMax Hailuo-02 model.

model.tooltip: Model to use for video generation.

ratio.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video.

duration.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-15).

seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same request with the same seed gives similar, but not guaranteed identical, results.

watermark.tooltip: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video.

MinimaxHailuo03TextToVideoNode.name: MinimaxHailuo03TextToVideoNode
MinimaxHailuo03TextToVideoNode.description: Generate video from a text prompt using the MiniMax H3 model.

model.tooltip: Model to use for video generation.

duration.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-15).

first_frame.tooltip: First frame image for the video.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same request with the same seed gives similar, but not guaranteed identical, results.

watermark.tooltip: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video.

last_frame.tooltip: Optional last frame image for the video.

MinimaxHailuo03FirstLastFrameNode.name: MinimaxHailuo03FirstLastFrameNode
MinimaxHailuo03FirstLastFrameNode.description: Generate video from a first frame image and an optional last frame image using the MiniMax H3 model. The aspect ratio of the video follows the supplied images.

model.tooltip: Model to use for video generation.

ratio.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the output video.

duration.tooltip: Duration of the output video in seconds (4-15).

reference_images.tooltip: Subject or style reference images, referred to in the prompt as 'Image 1'..'Image 9' in connection order. Up to 9 images.

reference_videos.tooltip: Motion or scene reference videos, referred to in the prompt as 'Video 1'..'Video 3' in connection order. Up to 3 videos, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total.

reference_audios.tooltip: Audio references, referred to in the prompt as 'Audio 1'..'Audio 3' in connection order. Up to 3 clips, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total. Cannot be used without a reference image or video.

seed.tooltip: Random seed. The same request with the same seed gives similar, but not guaranteed identical, results.

watermark.tooltip: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video.

MinimaxHailuo03ReferenceNode.name: MinimaxHailuo03ReferenceNode
MinimaxHailuo03ReferenceNode.description: Generate video conditioned on reference images, videos, and audio using the MiniMax H3 model. Refer to the references in the prompt by their order: 'Image 1', 'Image 2', 'Video 1', 'Audio 1', and so on.

model.tooltip: Model to use for prompt enhancement.

prompt.tooltip: Description of the video you intend to generate.

duration.tooltip: Duration of the video you intend to generate, in seconds (4-15).

ratio.tooltip: Aspect ratio of the video you intend to generate. 'adaptive' requires at least one image, video, or audio input.

reference_images.tooltip: Subject or style reference images, referred to in the prompt as 'Image 1'..'Image 9' in connection order. Up to 9 images.

reference_videos.tooltip: Motion or scene reference videos, referred to in the prompt as 'Video 1'..'Video 3' in connection order. Up to 3 videos, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total.

reference_audios.tooltip: Audio references, referred to in the prompt as 'Audio 1'..'Audio 3' in connection order. Up to 3 clips, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total. Cannot be used without a reference image or video.

first_frame.tooltip: First frame of the video you intend to generate. Cannot be combined with reference media.

last_frame.tooltip: Last frame of the video you intend to generate. Cannot be combined with reference media.

MinimaxHailuo03ContextIRNode.name: MinimaxHailuo03ContextIRNode
MinimaxHailuo03ContextIRNode.description: Analyze text and media context with MiniMax H3 Context IR and produce an enhanced, structured video prompt. Feed the output into the prompt of a MiniMax H3 video node and attach the same media there in the same order, because the enhanced prompt refers to the attached media by position.

model.tooltip: Model to use for video regeneration.

prompt.tooltip: The exact prompt used to generate the source video.

resolution.tooltip: Resolution to re-render the source video at.

reference_images.tooltip: Reference images from the original generation, in the same order. Up to 9 images.

reference_videos.tooltip: Reference videos from the original generation, in the same order. Up to 3 videos, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total.

reference_audios.tooltip: Audio references from the original generation, in the same order. Up to 3 clips, 2-15 seconds each, 15 seconds in total. Cannot be used without a reference image or video.

video.tooltip: The MiniMax H3 768P output video to re-render. Connect the unmodified output of a MiniMax H3 video node (24 FPS, 4-15 seconds). 2K outputs cannot be used.

watermark.tooltip: Whether to add an AIGC watermark to the video.

first_frame.tooltip: First frame image from the original generation, if one was used.

last_frame.tooltip: Last frame image from the original generation, if one was used.

MinimaxHailuo03RegenerateNode.name: MinimaxHailuo03RegenerateNode
MinimaxHailuo03RegenerateNode.description: Re-render a MiniMax H3 768P output at 2K resolution. Connect the unmodified 768P video and the exact prompt used to generate it; if the original generation used first/last frames or reference media, attach the same inputs.
